nodes.title: Covered fraction of a ball

nodes.summary: For a natural number $d$, the density of a set $X \subseteq \mathbb{R}^d$ is the limit superior, as $R \to \infty$, of the covered fraction of $X$ at radius $R$: the fraction of the open ball of radius $R$ about the origin covered by the open unit balls centred at points of $X$.
nodes.title: Density of a sphere packing

nodes.summary: For a natural number $d$, $\mathbb{R}^d$ denotes the $d$-dimensional real Euclidean space: $d$-tuples of real numbers with the Euclidean norm.
nodes.title: Euclidean space for sphere packings

nodes.summary: For a natural number $d$, a set $X \subseteq \mathbb{R}^d$ is the centre set of a unit sphere packing if the open balls of radius $1$ centred at any two distinct points of $X$ are disjoint.
nodes.title: Unit sphere packing

nodes.summary: Let $\Delta(3)$ be the supremum of the densities of all unit sphere packings in $\mathbb{R}^3$. Then $\Delta(3) = \pi / \sqrt{18}$.
nodes.title: Kepler conjecture

nodes.summary: For a natural number $d$, $\Delta(d)$ is the supremum of the densities of all unit sphere packings in $\mathbb{R}^d$.
nodes.title: Optimal sphere packing density

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
